# Bilsel Kongreleri

> > Bilsel Kongreleri organizes international scientific research and innovation congresses across Turkey's historic regions.

Bilsel Kongreleri is a platform dedicated to hosting and promoting international academic conferences focused on scientific research and innovation. The organization runs multiple congresses in different Turkish locations, including the Efes Congress in Izmir and the TurAbdin Congress, bringing together researchers and academics for collaborative knowledge exchange.

## Key Topics

- International Conference
- Scientific Research
- Innovation Congress
- Academic Event
- Research Symposium
- Bilsel Kongreleri
- Efes Congress
- TurAbdin Congress
- Izmir
- Academic Conference
- Bilimsel Araştırmalar
- İnovasyon
- Uluslararası Etkinlik

## Featured Congresses

- [IX. Bilsel Uluslararası Efes Bilimsel Araştırmalar ve İnovasyon Kongresi](https://bilselkongreleri.com/kongreler/vii-bilsel-uluslararasi-efes-bilimsel-arastirmalar-ve-inovasyon-kongresi-izmir): The 9th International Bilsel Efes Scientific Research and Innovation Congress held in Izmir, bringing together international researchers and innovators
- [VII. Bilsel Uluslararası TurAbdin Bilimsel Araştırmalar ve İnovasyon Kongresi](https://bilselkongreleri.com/kongreler/v-bilsel-uluslararasi-turabdin-bilimsel-arastirmalar-ve-inovasyon-kongresi): The 7th International Bilsel TurAbdin Scientific Research and Innovation Congress focusing on regional academic collaboration and innovation
